raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  version: "1.2.1"

package:
  name: ocaml-ppx-derivers
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/ocaml-ppx/ppx_derivers/archive/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: b6595ee187dea792b31fc54a0e1524ab1e48bc6068d3066c45215a138cc73b95

build:
  number: 0
  skip:
    - win
  script:
    - dune build --profile=release -p ppx_derivers @install
    - dune install --prefix="${PREFIX}" --libdir="${PREFIX}/lib/ocaml" ppx_derivers

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("ocaml") }}
    - ocaml-dune >=1.0
  host:
    - ocaml >=4.02.3

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        - lib/ocaml/ppx_derivers/*
        - doc/ppx_derivers/*

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/ocaml-ppx/ppx_derivers
  repository: https://github.com/ocaml-ppx/ppx_derivers
  summary: Shared ppx_deriving and ppx_type_conv registry for ppx derivers
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.md

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - ManuelLerchner
    - MementoRC
